item.name: Human
item.obtainment: Use a Race Reroll at the Race Reroll NPC in Lineage Town.
item.cardSummary: The Common starter race with no stat bonuses. Most Race Rerolls land here.

item.name: Skypian
item.obtainment: Use a Race Reroll at the Race Reroll NPC in Lineage Town.
item.cardSummary: An Uncommon reroll race that adds two extra Geppo uses and nothing else.

item.name: Elf
item.obtainment: Use a Race Reroll at the Race Reroll NPC in Lineage Town.
item.cardSummary: A Rare farming race that boosts gold and gem gains. It does not raise combat stats.

item.name: Vampire
item.obtainment: Use a Race Reroll at the Race Reroll NPC in Lineage Town.
item.cardSummary: An Epic reroll race with a small damage bump and light lifesteal. It is the first combat-focused roll most players keep.

item.name: Shinigami
item.obtainment: Use a Race Reroll at the Race Reroll NPC in Lineage Town.
item.cardSummary: A Legendary sword race with extra max health. You need this race before you can start the True Shinigami quest.

item.name: Player
item.buffs: +17.5% sword damage, -5% cooldown, +5% Player's Dagger damage
item.obtainment: Use a Race Reroll at the Race Reroll NPC in Lineage Town. Player shares the 0.25% Mythical bucket.
item.cardSummary: A Mythical sword race with cooldown reduction and a Player's Dagger bonus. It comes from the same rare Mythical reroll pool as the other late reroll races.

item.name: Curse
item.buffs: +17.5% melee damage, +30% max HP, +5% Sukuna damage, +10% crit damage
item.obtainment: Use a Race Reroll at the Race Reroll NPC in Lineage Town. Curse shares the 0.25% Mythical bucket.
item.cardSummary: A Mythical melee race with a large max HP bonus and extra Sukuna damage. Roll for it when you are building around Sukuna.

item.name: Eminence
item.buffs: +20% sword damage, +5% crit damage, +5% Shadow damage, -5% cooldown
item.obtainment: Use a Race Reroll at the Race Reroll NPC in Lineage Town. Eminence shares the 0.25% Mythical bucket.
item.cardSummary: A Mythical sword race that also buffs Shadow and lowers cooldown. Shadow mastery asks for this race.

item.name: Archon
item.buffs: +20% sword damage, +10% crit damage, +5% Raiden damage, +5% overall damage
item.obtainment: Use a Race Reroll at the Race Reroll NPC in Lineage Town. Archon shares the 0.25% Mythical bucket.
item.cardSummary: A Mythical sword race with extra overall damage and a Raiden bonus. The Raiden seller requires this race.

item.name: Demi God
item.obtainment: Use a Race Reroll at the Race Reroll NPC in Lineage Town. Demi God shares the 0.25% Mythical bucket.
item.cardSummary: A Mythical melee race with the strongest listed cooldown cut and a Gilgamesh bonus. Gilgamesh mastery requires it.

item.name: Quincy
item.buffs: +22.5% melee damage, +10% crit damage, -5% cooldown, +5% Yhwach damage
item.obtainment: Use a Race Reroll at the Race Reroll NPC in Lineage Town. Quincy shares the 0.25% Mythical bucket.
item.cardSummary: A Mythical melee race that also buffs Yhwach. You need Quincy before the Yhwach seller will complete the purchase.

item.name: Slime
item.buffs: +20% melee damage, +25% max HP, +5% Rimuru damage, +5% crit chance
item.obtainment: Use a Slime item dropped by Rimuru on Fossil Island. Each use has a 5% chance to grant Slime.
item.cardSummary: An exclusive melee race with extra max HP, crit chance, and Rimuru damage. You cannot reroll it. Use the Slime item from Rimuru, knowing most uses fail.

item.name: True Shinigami
item.buffs: +25% melee damage, -5% cooldown, +5% crit chance, +35% max health
item.obtainment: Talk to the True Shinigami NPC in Hueco Mundo while you already have Shinigami, then complete the quest to kill 500 Hollows.
item.cardSummary: An exclusive melee race with the largest listed max-health bonus. It is a Hueco Mundo quest, not a reroll, and Aizen requires it.

item.name: Vessel
item.buffs: +22.5% melee damage, +5% Sukuna (Shinjuku) damage, +10% crit damage, +30% max health
item.obtainment: Give 20 True Sukuna Fingers to the Vessel NPC on Shinjuku Showdown.
item.cardSummary: An exclusive melee race built around Sukuna (Shinjuku). Hand in 20 True Sukuna Fingers at Shinjuku Showdown instead of using Race Rerolls.

item.name: Enlightened
item.buffs: +20% overall damage, +5% Gojo (Shinjuku) damage, -5% cooldown, +5% crit chance
item.obtainment: Give 2 True Six Eyes to the Enlightened NPC on Shinjuku Showdown.
item.cardSummary: An exclusive race that raises overall damage, crit chance, and Gojo (Shinjuku) damage. Unlock it by handing 2 True Six Eyes to the Shinjuku Showdown NPC.

item.name: Frost Kitsune
item.buffs: +25% weapon damage, +5% Miyabi damage, +8% crit damage, +4% crit chance
item.obtainment: Use a Frozen Sakura item. Each use has a 10% chance to grant Frost Kitsune. Frozen Sakura comes from the Miyabi banner.
item.cardSummary: An exclusive weapon race with Miyabi damage and crit bonuses. Consume Frozen Sakura from the Miyabi banner. Most uses miss.

item.name: Monarch
item.buffs: +27.5% weapon damage, +5% Shadow's Dagger damage, -5% cooldown
item.cardSummary: An exclusive weapon race with the highest listed weapon-damage bonus and a Shadow's Dagger bump. It comes from using a Black Heart, not from Race Rerolls.

item.name: Demon
item.obtainment: Give 10 Blue Spider Lilies to the Muzan NPC. The flowers spawn on Fossil Island, Shinjuku Showdown, Lineage Town, Deeproot Jungle, and Legend's Arena.
item.cardSummary: An exclusive race with total damage, crit damage, and lifesteal. Kokushibo requires it. Hand 10 Blue Spider Lilies to Muzan instead of rerolling.

item.name: Glamoth
item.buffs: +24% melee damage, +10% crit damage, +5% Firefly damage, +4% crit chance
item.obtainment: Use a Glamoth Essence item. Each use has a 10% chance to grant Glamoth. Buy Glamoth Essence from the Armor Scrap shop for 50 Armor Scrap.
item.cardSummary: An exclusive melee race that also buffs Firefly. The Firefly seller requires it. Buy Glamoth Essence with Armor Scrap and use it until the 10% roll lands.
